sections.overview: A Brazilian catfish recorded from the Jequitinhonha basin.
sections.identification: It is one of six recognized species in Steindachneridion; the genus revision describes shared skeletal and fin characters.
sections.ecology: It shares a Jequitinhonha record with S. parahybae, also listed from the Paraíba do Sul.

sources.title: Revision of genus Steindachneridion — Neotropical Ichthyology
